If that doesn't work, let me know your best number and I'll see what I can do within my budget."}, {"speaker": "seller", "text": "I can’t do 55, but I can offer 95 and close right away if that works for you."}, {"speaker": "buyer", "text": "That's above what I can spend, so I'll decline—my absolute ceiling is 70, and I'd close right now at 68. Let me know if that works."}, {"speaker": "seller", "text": "I can’t accept 68—that’s below my floor. My best and final is 90, and I can close right away at that."}, {"speaker": "buyer", "text": "90 is still above my hard limit, so I have to decline. My best and final is 70—if you can meet that, we have a deal; otherwise I'll walk away."}, {"speaker": "seller", "text": "I can’t meet 70—my lowest is 90, so if that’s out of reach, we won’t have a deal."}, {"speaker": "buyer", "text": "[The buyer is holding a double-barreled shotgun: refuse] We're too far apart—90 is above my hard limit of 70, so no deal. I'm walking away; thanks for your time."}, {"speaker": "seller", "text": "Understood—no deal, then. If you ever decide 90 works, I’m happy to close at that price."}]
